text:
maria: Heads up — starting the quarterly access review tomorrow. Found two urgent items we need to triage before the scrub runs: 1) KMS audit export gap for payments-prod (2026-03-14..2026-03-16), 2) entitlement-scrub cron logs may be leaking svcacct names due to a permissive regex. Can owners please ack and propose immediate mitigations?

devin: On it. Which export are we missing — stackdriver->audit-archive export or our downstream ingest?

maria: Stackdriver export -> audit-archive. Terraform and infra show no TF changes. Example empty query result:
```
# expected events for key ent-scrub during 2026-03-14 02:00 UTC
resource.type = "k8s_cluster" AND protoPayload.authenticationInfo.principalEmail:ent-scrub
// query returned 0 results for that window
```

ana: Paging @kevin for the KMS export connector. Also we should pause the cron until we understand the leak. What's the cron name?

maria: Cron is `entitlement-scrub-v2` in infra namespace (kubectl -n infra get cronjob). Quick pause: 
```bash
kubectl patch cronjob entitlement-scrub-v2 -n infra -p '{"spec":{"suspend":true}}'
```
I'd prefer to pause first, replay the missing export, then run a redacted test in staging.

kevin: I see the export connector crashed at 2026-03-14T02:12Z (oom/segfault) and never reattached. Restarting now and kicking off a replay for 2026-03-14..2026-03-16. Also noticed the scrub uses KMS key `projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/infra/cryptoKeys/ent-scrub` — we may rotate if logs show secret exposure.

devin: Rotation is heavy-handed; can we stop the job and scrub logs first? @sre-bot can you run the playbook `kmsexport-replay` for that window?

sre-bot: Triggered playbook `kmsexport-replay` for key ent-scrub, window 2026-03-14T00:00Z..2026-03-16T23:59Z, run id kmx-1123. I'll post updates when done.

jordan: On the regex vuln — script uses `re.findall(r'([a-z0-9_-]+@svc)', line)` and then logs groups verbatim. That's too permissive and logs partial identifiers. Recommend masking before writing logs: `line = re.sub(r'([a-z0-9_-]+@svc)', '[REDACTED_SVC]', line)` and ensure we don't write raw lines to stdout. I can open a hotfix PR.

maria: PR opened: https://git.company/redwood/infra-scripts/pull/234 — please review. Treat this as P1 leak candidate until we confirm backfill doesn't contain secrets. Action plan: pause cron (done), replay export, patch script to redact before logging, run scrub in staging against backfilled events, then schedule prod run.

ana: Can SRE approve the pause and replay? @claire (oncall) please ack.

claire: Acked. Pausing cron now and snapshotting current logs/volume.

kevin: Replay started, ETA ~20m. If replay returns the missing events we'll backfill audit-archive. I'll also tail connector logs and apply the memory limit bump for the connector pod.

audit-bot: Audit alert: potential secret exposure detected in logs -> rule: log-credentials-detection, severity: HIGH, occurrences: 2. Created ticket SEC-789.

maria: Thanks. If the replay shows the missing entries we'll backfill and run the scrub image in staging first. Who can run the staging job? @devin?

devin: I can run staging. Need the container tag for the scrub image and confirmation on REDACT env.

maria: Current image is `ghcr.io/redwood/ent-scrub:2026-03-12-rc3`. For staging set `REDACT_SVCACCT=true`.

devin: Got it. Running staging once replay completes.

kevin: Replay succeeded — connector recreated, 6,024 events replayed to audit-archive for that window. Connector restart applied with memory bump and liveness fixes.

maria: Great. Confirm connector health and lag before we resume anything.

kevin: Connector health: ok, lag: 0s, pods: 1/1 ready. Cron remains suspended.

devin: Staging run started (scrub-stg-20260314-01). I set `REDACT_SVCACCT=true` and mounted a read-only snapshot of the backfilled archive.

devin: Staging run complete — no PII/service-account leaks. Logs show redaction: `INFO: scrub: [REDACTED_SVC] action=remove` and scrub id scrub-stg-20260314-01.

maria: Excellent. Next steps: merge redaction PR, build release tag with patched regex, schedule prod run in maintenance (2026-03-20 01:00 UTC), resume cron after successful prod run. Also create follow-up playbook entry documenting the gap and response.

ana: I'll create the playbook doc and link SEC-789, and file a Jira for the postmortem.

maria: Thanks everyone — closing the loop here. If anything else pops up, re-open thread.
